fusions.name: Unshaped Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes out an arm of raw arcana that deals 35 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at the full 6 tiles. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Raw Pulse
fusions.desc: Pulses raw arcana out through all eight arms, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Through the Suckers
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Loose Arm
fusions.desc: When you gain mana, a loose arm of raw arcana lashes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
